items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oscar Brown and Maya are the ones who encouraged me to see myself as a writer.

ctx.x: You talked about the responsibility of the artist. At what point did you start to identify yourself as an artist with that ability and that responsibility? At what point did that -­

When I met all these other artists. Yeah. You talked about the artists. I never heard about it or knew anything about it and I thought okay. Oscar Brown and Maya are the ones who encouraged me to see myself as a writer. I discovered that if you can spell and you can write, you're a writer. If you have any thoughts at all, you can write. To be wise is another thing. I'd like to be wise. I'd like to be wiser than I am, but I try. I try to work towards that end. I like to live an intelligent life, you know. I don't…
When you look at it, what do you -- what's your sense of what you are leaving for -­
